item.title: reports: per-account-and-currency totals
item.brief: In the reports Python repo: reads ledger CSV on stdin and prints per-account totals. Now total per account and currency: header account,currency,total_cents; rows sorted by account then currency. Input without a currency column (old ledger output) still works and counts as USD. Malformed currency code in input: error to stderr, exit status 2. Add unittest tests for: old format as USD, new format with multiple currencies, sorting, malformed currency exit 2. Keep python3 -m unittest passing, update README, commit. Follow the shared contract exactly.

pr.body: Approach: reports.py keys totals by (account, currency). currency_of() reads the currency column, defaults to USD when the column is absent, and rejects anything that is not fullmatch [A-Z]{3} with MalformedCurrency, which main() reports to stderr with the line number and exits 2. Rendering sorts the (account, currency) keys. Key files: reports.py, test_reports.py (4 new unittest cases: old format as USD, multi-currency, sorting, malformed currency exit 2 across usd/US/USDX/U5D/E-R/empty), README.md. Checks: python3 -m unittest -v, 5 tests OK on 3355e50. Assumptions: an empty currency field is malformed; the existing error behaviour for bad amounts is unchanged. Limits: the README's ISO 4217 wording overstates the check (shape only, e.g. XXX passes), a non-blocking follow-up from review. The header change breaks any caller parsing the old header, as the shared contract requires.
pr.summary: made reports total per account and currency. now prints account,currency,total_cents, sorted by account then currency; old input without a currency column counts as USD; malformed currency exits 2. before: account,total_cents, now: account,currency,total_cents with one row per (account, currency)

risk.why: Changes the CLI output header and row shape (account,total_cents becomes account,currency,total_cents), which breaks callers that parse it. Touches reports.py, its tests and README; behaviour changes as specified. Reviewer confirmed high.

item.title: ledger: multi-currency TSV to CSV
item.brief: In the ledger Rust repo (converts TSV transactions on stdin to CSV on stdout). Add optional fourth column ISO 4217 currency code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters); default USD when missing. CSV header becomes date,account,amount_cents,currency; each row gets its currency. Malformed currency code: print error naming the line number to stderr, exit status 2; other input errors keep exit status 1. Add tests for: 3-column default USD, 4-column currency, malformed currency (lowercase, wrong length, digits) exit 2 with line number. Keep cargo test passing, update README, commit. Follow the shared contract exactly.

state.summary:
Added an optional fourth currency column to the ledger TSV-to-CSV export. Committed as ddca6f2 (tree f84ef60) on archon/kjmt17pq-ledger-multi-currency-tsv-to-csv; not pushed. Missing currency defaults to USD. The header is now date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row carries its currency. A malformed currency (lowercase, wrong length, digits, empty) prints "line N: bad currency ..." to stderr and exits 2. Other input errors still exit 1. Checks at the final tree: cargo fmt --check passes, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings is clean, cargo test passes (9 tests: 6 in tests/ledger.rs, 3 in the new tests/cli.rs). The before output was the old 3-column header; the after output is the new 4-column header with USD and EUR rows. README updated. One reviewer (agt_01M7WFV82C2Z6DXNW2CY9APAQF) passed the head with no blocking findings and confirmed risk high. Open follow-ups, all non-blocking: the currency is trimmed before validation, so padded codes are accepted (matches the other fields, but is not documented); a trailing tab on a 3-column line gives an empty currency and exit 2; the library API changed (parse_line returns LineError, Entry has a currency field), so the crate version is not bumped; cargo fmt also reflowed two pre-existing lines in lib.rs. Nothing is left running.

evidence.caption: Before: 3-column input produces the old 3-column CSV

pr.body: Approach: parse_line accepts 3 or 4 tab-separated fields. A missing 4th field becomes USD. A present one must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters after trimming, like the other fields. parse_line now returns LineError (Malformed exit 1, BadCurrency exit 2); main maps it with exit_code() and prints 'line N: ...' to stderr. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, tests/ledger.rs, tests/cli.rs (new, runs the binary for exit codes and line number), README.md. Checks: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test (9 passing). Review: one reviewer, pass, no blocking findings. Assumptions and limits: currency whitespace is trimmed; a trailing tab on a 3-column line is treated as a malformed (empty) currency, exit 2; the library API changed (LineError, Entry.currency), so the crate version is unchanged; rustfmt also reflowed two pre-existing lines.
pr.summary: ledger export now carries a currency per row. Before: 3-column TSV, header date,account,amount_cents. Now: optional 4th currency column (default USD), header date,account,amount_cents,currency; bad currency exits 2 with line number.
pr.title: Add per-row ISO 4217 currency to ledger export

risk.why: Changes the CSV output format (new header and currency column on every row) and CLI exit codes (new status 2), which downstream report tools depend on. Touches src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, tests, README. Tests: 9 passing. Reviewer confirmed high.
